authorization.speaker: Steve
authorization.quote: While Claude reviews, I accept its recommendations:

decisions.image: READY is reached by cross-loading level-0 into the bootstrap heap and code set and loading level-1 as precompiled bundles through the read-only namespace on the target; CLOS is built on the target by loading l1-clos-boot and l1-clos. The projected image of R1-R13 is qualification scaffolding for the accepted lowerings and source branches and is retired as the boot executes what it covers. (Amended 2026-09-24; original text in amendments[0].)
decisions.coverage: Measure executed original definitions; enumerate target replacements separately, without a numerical cap. No 100-percent admission requirement. The selected READY dependency closure must still be complete and installed; missing dependencies cannot be hidden by coverage totals.
decisions.conditions: Class mode is mandatory for the READY profile. The legacy condition-mask path is excluded from Stage 1 READY acceptance; historical evidence remains valid in its original scope.
decisions.concurrency: One Lisp Worker, scheduler disabled. Multi-worker scheduling remains a later profile. POSIX and terminate-when-unreachable remain excluded.
decisions.dispatch: Uncached standard GF dispatch is admitted at READY without a timing claim. Dispatch caching follows READY.
decisions.sequencing: The next runtime packets are S1-NAMESPACE-a (NSL-1), then the cross-load writer, target bundle loader and staged boot (NSL-2 to NSL-4) of namespace-loader-plan.md. No further projection growth for its own sake. LL03, LL22 and LL24 controls may execute independently. (Amended 2026-09-24; original text in amendments[0].)
decisions.startup_boundary: Working host-backed stdout/stderr; startup-ccl runs in the initial process; interactive listener and in-image compiler follow READY.

implementation_choices.coverage_floor: Retain the currently qualified 550 executed originals (515 with non-NIL witnesses) as a non-regression baseline. This is an author-selected validation floor, not an additional quotation from Steve. READY-selected initialization and callable dependencies require their own actual execution and binding evidence.
implementation_choices.projection_limits: Name the selected classes, methods, globals, closures and modules; preserve identity and reject an unresolved required link. Native caches and native addresses are not transferable state.
implementation_choices.pending_review: class-image at ce865269 remains unreviewed. This decision does not accept or integrate that implementation.

authorization.context: Q-A of doc/WASM/stage1/namespace-loader-plan.md (NSL-P1), after Codex's review in namespace-loader-review.md and Claude audit 175

superseded.image: READY starts from an identity-preserving projection of the pinned native image. Building CLOS from source on the target is Stage 2 work.
superseded.sequencing: The next runtime packet is the projected-image READY join (LL15-a), measuring LL15-c/d in the same packet. No further separate service packet unless READY demonstrably needs it. LL03, LL22 and LL24 controls may execute independently.

notes: The executed-original regression floor of implementation_choices.coverage_floor stands; the accepted count is now 568 executed / 531 non-NIL per acceptance-ready-runtime.json.
implementation_choices.projection_limits continues to govern the projected image while it remains in use as qualification scaffolding.
The 25-replacement cap applies to target branches that replace a level-0/level-1 definition body under the boot path as it did under projection.
No inventory criterion, accepted record or packet is changed by this amendment.

authorization.speaker: Steve
authorization.question: For the READY profile, I recommend working host-backed stdout/stderr, running startup-ccl in the initial process, and deferring the interactive listener and in-image compiler until after READY. Does that match your intended boundary?

notes: This is a profile ruling, not evidence that READY has executed.
Host-backed output must support ordinary stream operations and flushing.
The initial process runs startup-ccl without creating a listener thread.
Interactive listener and in-image EVAL/COMPILE/COMPILE-FILE are deferred until after READY.

superseded.coverage: Measure executed original definitions; enumerate target replacements separately, capped at 25. No 100-percent admission requirement. The selected READY dependency closure must still be complete and installed; missing dependencies cannot be hidden by coverage totals.

notes: Target replacements remain named and attributed separately from executed originals.
This removes the numerical replacement cap, not dependency closure, native comparison, refusal evidence or adversarial review requirements.
The cap statements in A1 and NSL-P2 P5-2 are superseded.
